limitations: Chromium headless/Linux; responsive viewports, not physical phone hardware.
Speech policy uses controlled mocks; actual Arabic speech hardware/pack not tested.
Worker failure and watchdog use controlled faults.
OCR uses a real printed fixture; arbitrary handwriting is not guaranteed.
Complex integer powers |n|<=10^12; roots n<=32; trigonometric identities n<=12.
Probability workbench is bounded: urn draws<=32, colors<=8, discrete-law values<=100, joint law<=10x10, mixtures<=8 branches.
Exact rational arithmetic is bounded; binomial and normal distributions use finite-precision approximations. Underflow does not imply a mathematically impossible event or a verified zero variance.
Independent numerical checks are not proofs; unsupported or ambiguous cases ask for clarification.
Textbook and dialect support is rule-based and bounded, not a guarantee for all wording or dialects. Missing or ambiguous data still requires clarification.
Textbook image test uses real local OCR followed by explicit human review/correction. The radical was recognized as Vv3 in the printed fixture; mathematical OCR is not assumed infallible.
